ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Based on this food web, a decrease in the small fish and squid population would most directly decrease the available energy for whom?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram, “small fish and squid” is marked near the bottom middle position; “Emperor penguin” is marked above it and to the right. In the figure, there is an arrow from small fish and squid pointing to Emperor penguin. Reasoning: Food web arrows indicate that energy is transferred from the organism being eaten to the predator or consumer. Therefore, if the number of small fish and squid decreases, the one that most directly obtains less energy is the Emperor penguin, which directly uses them as an energy source.
